## Highlights

- On Stats, the charts now follow the months you choose. Switching from Year to date to Last 3 changes the Net by Period chart and the balance strip to show just those months, not the same twelve as before.
- The last month of your selection is the one highlighted, matching the figures under each chart.
- When you pick a single month, the charts step aside. The totals and balances for that month stay on screen.
- Long custom selections (more than twelve months) scroll sideways inside their card and open on your latest month. Shorter ones keep the usual column width, starting from the left.
- When your selection crosses into a new year, each January is labelled with its year so you can tell the years apart.
